'''Dewback paddocks''' was owned by [[Clarelle]] in [[Mos Shuuta/Legends|Mos Shuuta]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. A [[Dewback/Legends|dewback]] could be rented by 100 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] per day.
